lines.en: I push my cart out to restock.
The counter is low; I need two trips.

lines.zh: 我绕着货架走，数着格子。
lines.en: I circle the shelves counting slots.

lines.zh: 早上开店，我先擦一遍地板。
lines.en: I open in the morning by wiping the floor.

lines.zh: 我帽子里藏着一张价目表。
lines.en: A price list is hidden in my hat.
I walk to the back room with steady steps.

lines.zh: 这条路我一天走十几回。
lines.en: I walk this path a dozen times a day.

lines.zh: 我的账本夹在腋下，怕淋湿。
lines.en: I keep the ledger under my arm against rain.

lines.zh: 我走到门口，把牌子翻过来。
lines.en: I reach the door and flip the sign.

lines.zh: 搬箱子的时候我哼小曲。
lines.en: I hum a tune while hauling crates.
The shop is small; three steps and I reach the end.

lines.zh: 我先去东边看新到的货。
lines.en: I head east to check the new stock.
Walking fast winds me, so I go slowly.

lines.zh: 我挪动货架，让客人好过。
lines.en: I shift a shelf so customers can pass.

lines.zh: 我算今天的账，差两枚银币。
lines.en: I do the day's accounts; two silver are missing.

lines.zh: 我拿布擦柜台，擦到发亮。
lines.en: I wipe the counter until it shines.
With no customers, I sort the order sheets.
I arrange the goods by price.

lines.zh: 我打个哈欠，还是守着店。
lines.en: I yawn but keep minding the shop.
I counted three times; it is the same stock.
I am waiting for the delivery cart.
The weight slipped; I set it straight.

lines.zh: 我听见风声，以为是客人。
lines.en: I hear the wind and think it is a customer.
I keep the most expensive goods at the back.
Today's stock is a little damp.

lines.zh: 我坐着，手还在整理绳结。
lines.en: Sitting down, my hands still work the knots.
The lamp oil is low; I must note that.
I practice greetings at the empty shop.
Customer, what would you like to see?
Your boots are caked with mountain mud.
Would you look first, or talk price first?
You are blocking the light at the door.
Your eyes are counting my stock.
Do not touch that; someone ordered it.
You came at the right time; stock just arrived.
When I look at people, I look at their pockets.

lines.zh: 把帽子摘了，屋里不用遮。
lines.en: Take off your hat; no need for it indoors.
Your face says you want a discount.
I saved a good piece for you.
You still have not settled last time's debt.

lines.zh: 客人，别在柜台外头发呆。
lines.en: Customer, do not stand outside the counter daydreaming.
Kindly lift your hands from my counter.

lines.zh: 你是来买的，还是来打听的。
lines.en: Are you here to buy, or here to ask around?

lines.zh: 你的钱袋在腰上，我看得见。
lines.en: Your purse hangs at your waist, and I can see it.

lines.zh: 别碰我脸，客人要看笑脸。
lines.en: Not my face; customers expect a smile.
This one goes under shrinkage.
I have only ten hearts; be gentle.
You cannot afford to replace this counter.
I will not hit back unless you do that again.
My blood is cheap; the goods are not.
This punch costs me a day's profit.
Pain is pain; business is business.
You are hitting the shop, not the man.
I am raising prices because of you.

lines.zh: 我不吃这个，我吃你买的东西。
lines.en: I do not eat that; I eat what you buy.

lines.zh: 你拿食物抵账是不行的。
lines.en: You cannot pay your bill with food.
I neither buy nor eat this.
Take it away; do not dirty my goods.

lines.zh: 我闻到钱味，不闻面包味。
lines.en: I smell coins, not bread.
If you are buying it, I will take it.
This is worth only a few coppers.
My appetite is small; my business is large.

lines.zh: 你举着它晃，我只会摇头。
lines.en: Wave it around and I will only shake my head.
Do not offer bait as payment.
Careful, there are shelves behind you.

lines.zh: 你挤过来，我的单子掉了。
lines.en: You shoved in and my papers fell.
Do not bump the counter; the wood will split.
We collided; whose account does this go on?
Make way; I am carrying a crate.
You stepped on my scale.
This aisle fits only one person at a time.
Step back half a pace and I can pass.
Anything broken must be paid for at full price.
Do not crowd; queuing is part of business.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣守着另一家店。
lines.en: My partner keeps another shop.
We manage to meet twice each year.
The shop is my whole household.
I ask the price before I feel anything.
Two people running one shop would muddle the books.
I set aside a crate of sweets for her.
I keep my marriage by the ledger too.

lines.zh: 我们约好，谁先到谁开门。
lines.en: We agreed whoever arrives first opens up.

lines.zh: 我没空想这些，货还没点。
lines.en: No time for that; the stock is uncounted.

lines.zh: 家里那口子也嫌我算得细。
lines.en: My other half also finds me too exact.
This dropped coin is counterfeit.
I pick it up and put it back on the counter.

lines.zh: 掉的东西我先记进账里。
lines.en: I enter dropped items into the books first.
This crate split; I will swap it for another.
Do not press the scale while picking goods.

lines.zh: 我把散落的钉子收进盒里。
lines.en: I gather the loose nails into a box.
This sack is heavier than it looks.
Things on my floor are still mine.
I price things as I pick them up.
Goods received must be counted face to face.
Customer, do not rush off.

lines.zh: 你摸口袋的样子我看见了。
lines.en: I saw you feeling your pocket.
You mean to take goods without paying.

lines.zh: 这种眼神我见过太多次。
lines.en: I have seen that look far too often.
Stop; our account is not settled.

lines.zh: 你刚才藏了什么在袖子里。
lines.en: What did you just hide in your sleeve?
The shop is small; its rules are not.

lines.zh: 我喊一声，街上都听得见。
lines.en: If I shout, the whole street hears.
Do not make me put down the ledger.

lines.zh: 你走之前，先把货还回来。
lines.en: Before you go, return the goods.
My attention is on your sleeves.
I will remember wherever you go.
Someone watches the door; do not try.

lines.zh: 你绕一圈，还是回到我柜台前。
lines.en: You circle around and still come back to my counter.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声我记在心上。
lines.en: I keep a tally of every step you take.

lines.zh: 这条街的铺子都认识我。
lines.en: Every shop on this street knows me.
You slowed down; conscience, perhaps?
I watch you the way I watch accounts.
The back door is locked, and I hold the key.
Run if you like; the goods cannot.
A scale beam hurts too when swung.
That one is charged to your name.
I only hit thieves.
Do not hit back; my ledger is still open.
I use a broom, not a blade.
After this blow, prices stay the same.

lines.zh: 二十点血的我，还敢动手。
lines.en: With twenty health, I still swing.

lines.zh: 你逼一个生意人动了手。
lines.en: You made a merchant raise his hand.
I will book this punch as shrinkage.
After this, leave; do not hurt business.

lines.zh: 天亮了，我把门板卸下来。
lines.en: Day breaks and I take down the shutters.

lines.zh: 新铺子开张，第一笔半价。
lines.en: The new shop opens; first sale is half price.
I hang the sign straight.
The goods arrived; I signed the receipt.

lines.zh: 这条街上又多了个卖家。
lines.en: The street has one more seller now.
I count stock, starting from zero.
I haul in an old counter.

lines.zh: 早晨的空气里有铜锈味。
lines.en: The morning air smells of copper rust.
I set the cashbox by my feet.
First day open: no credit.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我的存货全完了。
lines.en: Fire takes my entire stock.
This fall hurts worse than losing money.

lines.zh: 水进了铺子，账本先抢救。
lines.en: Water is in the shop; save the ledger first.

lines.zh: 炸掉的是屋顶，账还在我怀里。
lines.en: The roof is gone; the ledger is in my arms.

lines.zh: 箭钉在柜台上，我给你算钱。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my counter; I will bill you.

lines.zh: 这股药味会让我货变色。
lines.en: This potion smell will discolor my goods.

lines.zh: 饿一顿没事，关门才要命。
lines.en: Missing a meal is fine; closing is fatal.

lines.zh: 雷劈了招牌，我明天重做。
lines.en: Lightning struck my sign; I will remake it.
No business can be done in the void.
